Use OULAD releases 2013B, 2013J and 2014B for training and 2014J for testing. Remove from training every learner present in test. Fix day 60 as the decision date and count only clicks on days 0 through 60, inclusive. Features are click count, active days, recency since last click and the count of distinct resources. Fit CatBoost (200 iterations, depth 4, learning rate .05) and standardized logistic regression with C=1. Outcome is recorded final withdrawal. Evaluate a retrospective all-enrollments model, its performance on still-registered students and a separately trained risk-set model on the same eligible students. Primary diagnostic is the within-model change in AUC from all records to the risk set. Exclude records whose registration had not yet begun. Report clustered bootstrap intervals by learner and denominators; this population change is descriptive.
